name: Login & Register Form by BestWebSoft – WordPress Website Access Control Plugin
author: bestwebsoft

sections.description:
Login & Register Form plugin is a simple and powerful tool to add user-friendly login and registration forms anywhere on your WordPress website. Customize forms, restrict user access by roles, enable email verification, and more.

Easily manage user authentication and access!

Free Features

  • Add custom login and register forms via shortcode
  • Enable/disable default WordPress login page
  • Allow registration via form or disable it completely
  • Redirect users after login, logout, and registration
  • Customize success and error messages
  • Compatible with latest WordPress version
  • Incredibly simple settings for fast setup without modifying code
  • Detailed step-by-step documentation and videos
  • Multilingual and RTL ready

Pro Features

All features from Free version included plus:

  • Enable Google reCAPTCHA v2 or v3 on login and register forms
  • Enable email confirmation for new user registrations
  • Customize email templates for user activation
  • Block registrations by email domain
  • Restrict access by user role
  • Export user list to CSV
  • Get answer to your support question within one business day (Support Policy)

Upgrade to Pro Now

If you have a feature suggestion or idea you’d like to see in the plugin, we’d love to hear about it! Suggest a Feature

Documentation & Videos

  • [Doc] User Guide
  • [Doc] Installation
  • [Doc] Purchase
  • [Video] Installation Instruction

Help & Support

Visit our Help Center if you have any questions, our friendly Support Team is happy to help — https://support.bestwebsoft.com/

Translation

  • Polish (pl_PL)
  • Russian (ru_RU)
  • Ukrainian (uk)

Some of these translations are not complete. We are constantly adding new features which should be translated. If you would like to create your own language pack or update the existing one, you can send the text of PO and MO files to BestWebSoft and we’ll add it to the plugin. You can download the latest version of the program for work with PO and MO files Poedit.

Recommended Plugins

  • Captcha – Protect WordPress login, registration, comments and other forms with CAPTCHA or reCAPTCHA.
  • Limit Attempts – Protect WordPress website against brute force attacks. Limit rate of login attempts.
sections.installation:
1. Upload login-register-form folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Plugin settings are located in ‘Login & Register Form’.

View a PDF version of Step-by-step Instruction on Plugin Installation
sections.faq:
Can I place the login or registration form on any page?

Yes, just use the shortcode [bws_login_register_form] on any page or post where you want to display the form.

How can I enable email verification for new users?

This feature is available in the Pro version. You can enable it from the plugin settings page and customize the confirmation email template.

Can I redirect users after login or logout?

Yes, you can set custom redirect URLs in the plugin settings.

What should I do if I can’t log in after plugin activation?

Please clear your browser cache and cookies. If the issue persists, disable the plugin via FTP or hosting panel and contact our support team.

Is it possible to limit access to certain roles?

Yes, the Pro version allows you to limit access to login/registration functionality based on user roles.

I have some problems with the plugin’s work. What Information should I provide to receive proper support?

Please make sure that the problem hasn’t been discussed yet on our forum (https://support.bestwebsoft.com). If no, please provide the following data along with your problem’s description:
– The link to the page where the problem occurs
– The name of the plugin and its version. If you are using a pro version – your order number.
– The version of your WordPress installation
– Copy and paste into the message your system status report. Please read more here: Instruction on System Status
